name: Skeleton
description: A placeholder shape that matches the layout while content loads: a block, a line of text or a circle. Skeletons are hidden from assistive technology; the container that is loading sets aria-busy.

props.name: shape
props.description: block (a rounded rectangle), text (a 10px line with line spacing) or circle. Emitted as data-shape.

props.name: width
props.description: A CSS length, such as 60% or 40px, written inline. React and Vue also take a number of px.

props.name: height
props.description: A CSS length, written inline. A text line keeps its own height unless this is set.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The shape (aria-hidden=true), with a shimmer that stops under reduced motion.

requirements: Skeletons are aria-hidden; the container that is loading sets aria-busy=true and drops it when the content arrives.
The shimmer moves in the reading direction and stops under reduced motion.
Don't show skeletons for more than a few seconds; switch to a status.
